author: Alice
text: Heads up team - the pricing policy was updated in March. Enterprise tier now includes unlimited seats, and the starter tier price dropped from $49 to $39/month.

author: Bob
text: Following up on the pricing change - Sales should update all outbound quotes starting April 1st. Let me know if you see any customer pushback.

author: Carol
text: Deployed the new rate limiter to production. Should reduce API timeout errors by about 40 percent. Rollback plan is in the runbook if anything breaks.

author: Dave
text: Nice work Carol. Also merged the fix for the websocket reconnect bug that has been flaky since May.

author: Alice
text: Reminder: all-hands is moved to Thursday 3pm this week because of the holiday on Monday.

author: Eve
text: Welcome to the team, Frank! He is joining as a backend engineer on the platform team.

author: Bob
text: Quick note - the enterprise unlimited-seats promo ends Sept 30. After that it reverts to per-seat billing above 50 users.

author: Grace
text: Open enrollment for benefits closes January 31st. Make sure to review your health plan options in the HR portal before then.

author: Grace
text: Reminder: performance review self-assessments are due April 15th. Managers will schedule 1:1s the following week.

author: Henry
text: We are seeing a spike in support tickets about the login timeout issue. Engineering is aware and working on a fix.

author: Henry
text: Login timeout issue is resolved as of this morning deploy. Thanks engineering team for the quick turnaround.

author: Ivy
text: Kicking off design reviews for the new dashboard redesign. First review is Friday at 2pm.

author: Ivy
text: Dashboard redesign beta is live for internal testing. Please file feedback in the product channel.

author: Jack
text: We are investigating elevated error rates on the API gateway. Incident channel is open, updates every 15 minutes.

author: Jack
text: Root cause identified: a bad config push to the load balancer. Rolling back now.

author: Jack
text: Incident resolved. Full postmortem will be posted in Drive by end of week.

author: Carol
text: Postmortem for the Aug 22 outage is up in Drive under Engineering. Summary: config validation gap, adding a pre-deploy check.

author: Grace
text: Parental leave policy has been updated - now offering 16 weeks paid leave for all new parents, up from 12.

author: Eve
text: Company all-hands next Thursday will cover the Q3 results and Q4 planning.

author: Alice
text: Getting a few questions about whether the seat-based pricing applies retroactively - confirming it only applies to new contracts signed after Oct 1.

author: Henry
text: Customer escalation on the Acme Retail account resolved - turned out to be a misconfigured webhook on their end.

author: Ivy
text: Dashboard redesign ships to all customers next Monday. Release notes are in the Product Notion space.

author: Dave
text: Heads up - upgrading the database to Postgres 17 this weekend. Expect a short maintenance window Saturday 2-4am UTC.

author: Grace
text: New hire orientation sessions are now every other Monday instead of weekly, given current hiring volume.
